1 ContractDTOs, sync table columns, endpoint shapes — written once, used by app and backendApp and backend compile against the same shapes
2 DomainEntities (UUID id, updatedAt, deletedAt, syncState), repository protocol, use casesBuilds; nothing uses them yet
3 Fake dataReal <Feature>RepositoryImpl over data source Impls that hold in-memory valuesRepository maps, catches, logs; dev menu seeds and resets
4 View modelsOne view model per screen, wired into the skeletonThe feature runs end to end with Continue offline
5 LocalData source Impl insides → SwiftData, Keychain, files, PlatformKitRelaunch keeps everything; nothing above the data source changed
6 BackendBuilt in site-log-be the same sprint: migration, route, testsIts guide is done; the app reaches it locally or on staging
7 SyncThe local data source adopts SyncableLocalDataSource and writes outbox rows; the table joins /sync/pull and /sync/pushSigned in: a second device sees the change
TestsTests listed in the guidebundle exec fastlane test green (site-log-be runs its own)
  • A step that does not apply is marked — in the guide's step table (for example: app lock has no backend).
  • From S2 on, a feature's sync step only makes its table syncable and registers it in App/DI/SyncTablesDI.swift; the engine is F04.
  • Features that talk to their own endpoints (upload, verify, push) swap a remote data source's insides to HTTPClient in this step instead.

blocks.html:
1. Offline first, inside every feature: the offline path works before the backend and sync steps start.
  2. No fake repositories: fake data lives only in data source Impls. The repository is real from step 3; step 5 and step 7 replace only the data source insides, never its type or DI registration.
  3. Continue offline is a product mode: test it in every sprint, next to the signed-in path.
  4. Task size 2–6h: a step above 6h is split into tasks when you start it; ~12–20 tasks per sprint.
  5. Tests after the feature works end to end, never while a step is half built.
  6. Visual finish waits for F18: until then a step changes layout only when a view model needs it.
  7. Tick the box in ROADMAP.md and the guide's status in the commit that finishes the step.
